purpose: Make operational knowledge structurally sufficient for execution readiness by embedding information/object resolution, evidence, applicability, validation, authority, exception and runtime-feedback semantics before recursive work decomposition.
principles: Operational Knowledge is executor-neutral canonical truth, not a runtime queue schema.
Information Resolution is a first-class component of Operational Knowledge v2, not a disconnected permanent layer.
Frozen assets are immutable; material enrichment creates a newer candidate version.
Authoritative claims are activated only within their stated jurisdiction, regime, condition and applicability.
Client/runtime labels without authoritative semantics remain explicit bindings or source-context gaps.
Runtime feedback may suggest knowledge gaps but cannot silently mutate canonical truth.

informationResolution.requiredFor: Every canonical information field/object whose meaning, applicability, origin, association, normalization, validation or conflict handling materially affects execution.

objectSemantics.rule: Documents and data objects are first-class reusable information contracts, not attachments to tasks.

provenance.rule: Task-level citation does not automatically prove every field-level rule.

runtimeFeedback.governanceFlow: runtime observation -> suggested gap -> source/owner validation -> canonical update where applicable -> new WorkDefinition/runtime projection -> retest

downstreamContract.gate: Do not compile executor-ready WorkDefinitions until material operational ambiguities and unresolved information semantics are either resolved or explicitly bound/escalated.
